procedures.title: Analyze and Improve UI/UX
procedures.description: To analyze and improve the frontend UI/UX of a repository.

procedures.title: Audit Repository
procedures.description: To conduct a comprehensive, evidence-based audit of a repository or live website.

procedures.title: Automate a Workflow That Can Report Its Own Failure
procedures.description: To replace a repeated manual sequence with a script whose main job is being able to tell you whether the work actually happened, because an automation that reports success while blind is worse than doing it by hand.

procedures.title: Build API-Driven Frontend
procedures.description: To build a modern, functional frontend for an application based on its backend API.

procedures.title: Build from Plan
procedures.description: To analyze a repository's blueprint/plan and current state, and iteratively implement the next logical steps to build a robust, production-grade system.

procedures.title: Curate Repository
procedures.description: To analyze an unknown repository, make safe, reversible improvements, and provide a clear report.

procedures.title: Fix a Bug, Failing Test First
procedures.description: To fix a reported bug in an order that proves the fix worked, by making the test fail for the reported reason before any code changes.

procedures.title: Fix and Refine
procedures.description: To transform a prototype or demo-quality project into a production-grade application.

procedures.title: Generate Prompt from Description
procedures.description: To generate a new, high-quality prompt from a user's description.

procedures.title: Initial Repository Hardening
procedures.description: To perform a one-time, comprehensive hardening and baselining pass on a new or unmaintained repository.

procedures.title: Iterative Repository Hardening
procedures.description: To perform ongoing, iterative improvements to a repository that has already been hardened.

procedures.title: Isolate Tests from External Services
procedures.description: To make a test suite runnable in an agent's sandbox by removing its dependence on services it cannot start.

procedures.title: Map the Architecture
procedures.description: To describe how the system actually works, by deriving it from what runs and what imports what rather than from the folder names.

procedures.title: Prove the Documentation Against the Code
procedures.description: To find the claims in the docs that were true when written and are not true now, by executing each one rather than reading it.

procedures.title: Prove the Fix by Making It Fail
procedures.description: To establish that a test added alongside a fix actually detects the defect, by putting the defect back and watching the test go red.

procedures.title: QA the Tests an Agent Wrote
procedures.description: To find the tests that pass because they were written from the implementation rather than from the requirement, and cannot fail.

procedures.title: Repair a Pipeline That Is Green Without Checking Anything
procedures.description: To find the CI steps that pass because they are not running what they claim, and make each one able to fail again.

procedures.title: Repair the Environment Setup Script
procedures.description: To diagnose and repair the setup script so agent tasks stop failing before any code is written.

procedures.title: Review an Agent-Written Pull Request
procedures.description: To review a pull request an agent wrote, against the failure modes agents actually have.

procedures.title: Run the Error Paths
procedures.description: To find the failure handling that has never once executed, by causing each failure on purpose and watching what the code actually does.

procedures.title: Scope a Vague Issue
procedures.description: To turn an underspecified bug report into a reproducible, testable task before any fix is attempted.

procedures.title: Security Review of Agent-Written Code
procedures.description: To review a change an agent wrote for the security defects agents specifically introduce.

procedures.title: Translate the Docs Without Forking Them
procedures.description: To add a language to a project's documentation together with the machinery that says when a translation has gone stale, because a translation nobody can tell is out of date is worse than no translation.

procedures.title: Update Dependencies
procedures.description: To update a project's dependencies to their latest compatible versions.

procedures.title: Verify a Database Migration Before It Meets Real Data
procedures.description: To find what a migration does at production row counts, on the production engine, and on the way back down, none of which a dev database can show you.
